newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Capetronic opens preference share offer.
newsitem.headline: Capetronic opens preference share offer.

text.p: Capetronic International Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it is offering 83.25 million convertible cumulative non-voting preference shares of HK$1.50 each in the proportion of one preference share for every two ordinary shares held.
The television and communication equipment maker said in a statement that the 5.0 percent preference share issue was passed by shareholders at a special general meeting on January 10.
The company would redeem the outstanding preference shares on the fifth anniversary of the date of the issue of the shares at the price of HK$1.5 each, it said in the prospectus document.
The preference shares can be converted into ordinary shares on one-for-one basis anytime in the five year period, it said.
Capetronic also said shareholders also approved the reduction of paid-up share capital of the company by cancelling the amount of HK$3.5 on each share of HK$5.00 in the company.
No application would be made for the listing of the preference shares, it added.
The proceeds from the preference share issue of about HK$124.9 million before expenses would be used as additional working capital and for future expansion, the prospectus said.
Shares of Capetronic were steady at HK$1.22 at midday.
